subject: There is a whole world at ankle height
preheader: A slow shore morning, a field notebook and a closer look.

attrs.alt: An ink-and-watercolour study of a shallow rock pool with olive seaweed, limpets, pebbles and a green sea anemone.

content.text: Slow down at the edge of a pool. Look for shapes, movement and the quiet details you usually walk past.
Make a few field sketches with your guide. You do not need to draw well to look closely.
Guided shore walk, time to sketch and a shared field notebook. Bring sturdy footwear and a layer for the coast.
Meet at Little Cove Field Station.
